mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may potentiate letrozole's potential for QT prolongation and arrhythmias; letrozole has minimal direct interaction but combined electrolyte depletion increases cardiac risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) regularly in patients receiving concurrent therapy; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation if hypokalemia develops.
